requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: The clone action can be behaviorally correct while its delivery evidence falsely omits prior independent rejection state or publishes a stale/non-terminal handoff.

risk_surfaces.reason: One clone POST per accepted action with re-entry blocked while cloning.
Independent rejection history and mandatory closure artifacts must agree with the persisted certificate metadata.
The published handoff identity must remain a direct result-only child of the certified material head.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A second interaction while the request is pending could produce a duplicate clone POST.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The button could issue more than one clone request or remain gated by a native confirmation dialog.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the exact-head implementation and correlate it with the exact-head regression suite and completed CI run.
negative_controls.expected: One clone POST per accepted action with re-entry blocked while cloning.
negative_controls.observed: Exact-head regression covers immediate POST, pending-state disabled button and no duplicate POST; Validate PR #7084 passed.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A handoff can claim no prior independent rejection while another certified evidence artifact records that such a rejection occurred.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Refresh evidence for a new material head but leave previous_independent_rejection=false and omit the mandatory rejection closures.
negative_controls.procedure: Cross-check every independent-rejection marker against handoff metadata, audit escape closure, learning closure and cumulative inherited controls.
negative_controls.expected: Any recorded independent rejection forces the certificate flag true and requires both closures plus inherited controls.
negative_controls.observed: The remediation explicitly records both rejections, sets the pending certificate flag to true, and creates the mandatory closure artifacts.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A result-only handoff can be published on top of an earlier result commit or include material paths, making the certificate stale or structurally invalid.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Regenerate handoff files without proving parent(material) and changed-path allowlist at the published head.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise terminal handoff parent and allowlist validators on synthetic siblings, then rerun the terminal gate with remote parent and changed paths after publication.
negative_controls.expected: The published handoff is a direct child of the material head and changes only certificate-allowlisted paths.
negative_controls.observed: Generic terminal-handoff contract tests covering missing child, material-path contamination and valid direct child all pass; exact remote gate is required after publication.
